_meta._comment: The bright-star catalogue — GENERATED by tools/pipeline/import-star-catalogue.js --write (plan 28 §B). Columnar: `columns` names the fields of every row of `stars`. Positions are ICRS at the catalogue epoch (J1991.25) — NOT propagated: the scene propagates each star from this epoch with its space velocity (plan 28 §C). distFlag: 0 the parallax (σ/π ≤ 0.2), 1 the posterior mode under the exponentially decreasing space density prior with the measured parallax and error (Bailer-Jones 2015; L = 1.35 kpc — the parallax is poor or non-positive, flagged), 2 no parallax error (500 pc). rvFlag: 0 no radial velocity (the transverse motion only), 1 Gaia DR3, 2 Pulkovo. Gate: tools/verify/star-catalogue.js.

units.pmRaMasYr: milliarcseconds per Julian year, μα cos δ

hipparcos.title: Hipparcos, the New Reduction (van Leeuwen 2007, A&A 474, 653) joined with the Hipparcos Catalogue (ESA 1997, SP-1200) — ESA, hosted by the Gaia archive (public.hipparcos_newreduction, public.hipparcos)
hipparcos.licence: ESA — free use with citation (the Hipparcos and Tycho Catalogues, ESA SP-1200; van Leeuwen 2007)
hipparcos.query: SELECT n.hip, n.ra, n.dec, n.plx, n.pm_ra, n.pm_de, n.e_plx, n.e_pm_ra, n.e_pm_de, n.hp_mag, h.vmag, h.b_v, h.e_b_v, h.hd, h.sptype FROM public.hipparcos_newreduction AS n JOIN public.hipparcos AS h ON h.hip = n.hip WHERE h.vmag <= 8.0 OR n.hp_mag <= 8.2

gaiaRv.title: Gaia DR3 radial velocities for Hipparcos stars (Gaia Collaboration 2023, A&A 674, A1; Katz et al. 2023; the hipparcos2_best_neighbour cross-match)
gaiaRv.query: SELECT x.original_ext_source_id AS hip, g.radial_velocity, g.radial_velocity_error, g.phot_g_mean_mag FROM gaiadr3.hipparcos2_best_neighbour AS x JOIN gaiadr3.gaia_source AS g ON g.source_id = x.source_id WHERE g.radial_velocity IS NOT NULL

pulkovo.title: Pulkovo radial velocities for 35,495 Hipparcos stars (Gontcharov 2006, Astron. Lett. 32, 759; VizieR III/252)
pulkovo.licence: VizieR catalogue — free use with citation

bsc.title: The Bright Star Catalogue, 5th revised ed. (Hoffleit & Warren 1991; VizieR V/50) — the HR numbers and the Bayer/Flamsteed designations

iauNames.title: IAU Catalog of Star Names (IAU-CSN), the Working Group on Star Names (WGSN); the official list https://www.iau.org/public/themes/naming_stars/
